text:
maria_cs: Hi team — customer CUST-5421 reports that after we pushed an SSO provision update their service key svc-xxxx now gets 403s for both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. They say it worked pre-push.

devon_prod: Yikes. Do we have the raw error they see? quick repro?

maria_cs: They provided this curl and response. Repro steps: 1) use svc key created via SSO push 2) call embeddings endpoint with small batch
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-ABCD1234" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["hello"]}'
```
Response: 
```json
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"missing_scope: embeddings, inference","status":"PERMISSION_DENIED"}}
```

raj_infra: That body explicitly lists scopes missing. Looks like the SCIM/SSO push omitted scopes on the service account. Which provisioner version did the customer use?

maria_cs: They used the enterprise SCIM sync (v2) via our Okta integration. They upgraded the connector yesterday and then ran a re-provision.

olivia_eng: Could be the new provisioner changed the scope mapping; we had a patch that defaults to "session-only" keys for interactive users. Service keys should get explicit inference + embeddings + rerank.

devon_prod: Can we reproduce quickly in staging? steps: create an SSO-provisioned svc key, call both endpoints. If 403, check key.scopes in admin UI and provisioning logs.

raj_infra: I'll spin up a repro tenant. Also checking our audit logs for scim:push events. If the push payload from Okta omits the custom claim for "allowed_scopes" we may be fallbacked to minimal.

maria_cs: Customer is blocked in prod — asked for ETA and workaround.

olivia_eng: Short-term workaround: create a manual API key from Org > Service keys and grant full scopes (generate, embeddings, rerank). That bypasses SSO provisioned key. Communicate to customer and mark as temporary.

devon_prod: For permanent fix we need a mapping patch backport to provisioner v2 that reads delegated_scopes from SCIM extension and populates KeyGrant properly. I'll open an infra ticket and link here.

oncall_bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-8734 — assigned to raj_infra and olivia_eng. Priority: P1-customer-blocker.

raj_infra: Repro in staging succeeded: SCIM payload missing extension X-scopes -> provisioner created key with empty scopes. I'll add validation to fail the push when required scopes are absent.

olivia_eng: I'll draft a customer response: apology, explain SSO push likely dropped scopes after connector upgrade, offer manual key or scoped patch timeline (ETA 6 hrs to hotfix + 24 hrs for rollout).

maria_cs: Customer accepted manual key for now and asked for the hotfix ETA. I've shared INC link and contact.

devon_prod: Next actions: (1) raj to deploy validation/hotfix to provisioner (2) olivia to prepare customer comms + postmortem template (3) maria to close loop with CUST-5421 when hotfix deployed.

raj_infra: Starting hotfix branch now, will push a canary in ~2h and update INC-2024-8734.

maria_cs: Thanks — marking this thread resolved for triage, will follow up when hotfix rolled. :thumbsup:
